label: sasuga
title: さすが (流石)
meaning_example: he won. After all, he is a fast runner

examples.japanese: さすが、彼は期待を裏切らないね。
examples.body_text:
さすが、彼は期待を裏切らないね。 

		That's just what one would 
		expect of 
		him.
examples.body_html:
さすが、彼は期待を裏切らないね。 
That's just what one would expect of him.

examples.japanese: さすがだね。君ならやってくれると思っていたよ。
examples.body_text:
さすがだね。君ならやってくれると思っていたよ。 

Excellent! 
		It's just like you to come through like that.
examples.body_html:
さすがだね。君ならやってくれると思っていたよ。 
Excellent! It's just like you to come through like that.

examples.japanese: さすがに偉大な学者だけあって、彼はその問いに容易に答えた。
examples.body_text:
さすがに偉大な学者だけあって、彼はその問いに容易に答えた。 

Like 
		the great scholar that he was, he answered the question easily.
examples.body_html:
さすがに偉大な学者だけあって、彼はその問いに容易に答えた。 
Like the great scholar that he was, he answered the question easily.

examples.japanese: 年の功と言うのか、彼の意見はさすがに一日の長があるね。
examples.body_text:
年の功と言うのか、彼の意見はさすがに一日の長があるね。 

		Maybe it's his age but his opinions seem a little more grounded in experience than everyone else's.
examples.body_html:
年の功と言うのか、彼の意見はさすがに一日の長があるね。 
Maybe it's his age but his opinions seem a little more grounded in experience than everyone else's.

examples.japanese: 彼はさすがに大学へ行っただけのことはある。
examples.body_text:
彼はさすがに大学へ行っただけのことはある。 

		He did not go to college for nothing.
examples.body_html:
彼はさすがに大学へ行っただけのことはある。 
He did not go to college for nothing.

examples.japanese: 本当の事を言ったとはさすがに勇気がある。
examples.body_text:
本当の事を言ったとはさすがに勇気がある。 

		You were courageous to tell the truth.
examples.body_html:
本当の事を言ったとはさすがに勇気がある。 
You were courageous to tell the truth.

comments.text: seems to usually be used for positive things. you would not say "he cheated. after all, he is a lawyer.."
comments.html: seems to usually be used for positive things. you would not say "he cheated. after all, he is a lawyer.."

comments.text:
This might be a good example of how to use さすが in a more casual way.



Last time I went to karaoke I went with a bunch of bandmen, and after a vocalist of a certain band blew us all away, everyone said at the same time「さすがにプロだね！！」
